method.rss: External ps RSS in KiB converted to bytes; nominal 100 ms interval plus process cost. In-flight sample can complete after response. Sampled maximum, not exact peak.
method.serverMemory: process.memoryUsage before, at response headers and after the HTTP handler, bytes; retained process, no forced GC.
method.elapsed: Parent fetch through complete body consumption; excludes assertions and sampler shutdown.
method.isolation: Copied app, synthetic logs and valid archives, all child fetch calls blocked, sequential requests, fresh server for each log workload.
method.limits: Two warm repeats; no p95, concurrent load, true cold disk cache, browser render/download, live logs, or Windows claims. Large CSV also has a consumer delayed 20 ms per read.
